# Chuyue “Steven” Wang

<samp>LLM inference &amp; agents · Penn ’29</samp>

I work on faster LLM inference at Penn’s [Distributed Systems Lab](https://dsl.cis.upenn.edu/) and evaluate AI for scientific peer review at [Wharton](https://statistics.wharton.upenn.edu/profile/bxzhao/). I contribute to the [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project) and [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project) ecosystems.

[Website](https://chuyuewang.vercel.app/) · [Writing](https://chuyuewang.vercel.app/blog) · [Email](mailto:wangcy07@sas.upenn.edu) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chuyue-wang/)
